description: This file defines an abstract class 'TypeSpec' and multiple concrete subclasses representing different type specifications in a serialization type system, including pointer, reference, array, generic, named, assembly-qualified, tuple, and literal types. It provides methods for formatting and string representation of these types.

classes.name: TypeSpec
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a type in the serialization system, with an abstract method 'Format' for string representation.

classes.name: PointerTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a pointer type, with a reference to its element type.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a reference type, with a reference to its element type.

classes.name: ArrayTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents an array type, with element type and number of dimensions.

classes.name: ConstructedGenericTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a constructed generic type, with unconstructed type, type arguments, and arity.

classes.name: NamedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a named type, possibly nested, with namespace and arity.

classes.name: AssemblyQualifiedTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a type with assembly qualification, including the type and assembly name.

classes.name: TupleTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a tuple type with elements and arity.

classes.name: LiteralTypeSpec
classes.description: Represents a literal type with a string value.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Abstract method to format the type as a string.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the type.

methods.name: GetNamespaceQualifiedName
methods.description: Returns the namespace-qualified name of a type, including containing types.
